cia-odni-osint-breach.title: CIA, ODNI and NGA open-source intel system breached
cia-odni-osint-breach.attacker: Unknown (NYT sources suggest China; AI tool ARTEX reportedly used, unconfirmed)
cia-odni-osint-breach.scale: Unclassified OSINT network; what was taken isn't known yet
cia-odni-osint-breach.status: ODNI says breach resolved; forensic investigation ongoing, no state attribution published
cia-odni-osint-breach.summary: Hackers got into an unclassified system US spy agencies use to analyze social media, satellite imagery and purchased data. Officials say classified networks weren't touched. Part of a wave of US federal intrusions that also hit the FBI and Treasury's FinCEN.

tweets.name: Reuters
tweets.text: US CIA, ODNI suffer cybersecurity breach of some unclassified information, source says

tweets.name: David DiMolfetta
tweets.text: CIA and ODNI discovered a breach of an unclassified system used to analyze public and commercially available information, better known as open-source intelligence, or OSINT. Confirming NYT.

tweets.name: OSINTdefender
tweets.text: …Yesterday it was reported that an open source analysis system used by the CIA, ODNI and National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency was breached…

treasury-fincen-intrusion.title: Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after intrusion
treasury-fincen-intrusion.victim: US Treasury, Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN)
treasury-fincen-intrusion.scale: "Limited subset" of systems accessed; some taken offline, BSA filing deadlines extended to Dec 30
treasury-fincen-intrusion.status: FBI, CISA and outside forensic examiners investigating; systems not named, no data loss disclosed
treasury-fincen-intrusion.summary: The bureau that collects banks' suspicious activity reports found unauthorized access to part of its network and pulled some systems offline, hours after the CIA/ODNI breach became public. No link between the incidents has been established.

tweets.name: The Record From Recorded Future News
tweets.text: The Treasury Department is the latest U.S. federal agency to be affected by a cyber incident, warning that it has taken some systems offline after a cyberattack resulted in "unauthorized access"…

tweets.name: Reuters
tweets.text: US FinCEN takes some systems offline after cyber incident, official says

tweets.name: OSINTdefender
tweets.text: The U.S. Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) says it is investigating a cybersecurity incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems…

1password-github-breach.title: 1Password customer data stolen via hacked employee GitHub account
1password-github-breach.scale: Customer names, emails and some recovery/invitation tokens; number of customers not disclosed
1password-github-breach.status: Disclosed Nov 25; contained, internal credentials rotated; vaults and encryption keys not compromised
1password-github-breach.summary: An attacker used a compromised employee GitHub account to push malicious code to 1Password's backend services and copy customer account data. Password vaults and the keys protecting them were not accessed.

tweets.name: BleepingComputer
tweets.text: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach

tweets.name: Cointelegraph
tweets.text: 🚨 ALERT: 1Password confirms a breach through an employee's GitHub account exposed customer names and emails, but says password vaults were not accessed.

tweets.name: The Verge
tweets.text: 1Password says the security breach didn't compromise its vaults, but didn't mention how many customers were affected.

n0n-financial-vendors.title: n0n extortion gang leaks Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan customer data via vendors
n0n-financial-vendors.victim: Third-party vendors of JPMorgan Chase, Visa, Mastercard and others
n0n-financial-vendors.scale: ~16,000 customer emails plus phone numbers and account IDs published; banks say core systems unaffected
n0n-financial-vendors.status: Data dumped after 48-hour deadline; banks say no card numbers taken
n0n-financial-vendors.summary: n0n claimed access to JPMorgan cardmember engagement records held by outside service providers and published customer names, emails, phone numbers and marketing records.

tweets.name: Cybernews
tweets.text: After a 48-hour countdown set for various companies to pay up the ransom passed, the ransomware gang n0n has dumped the stolen data of JPMorgan Chase…

tweets.name: FalconFeeds.io
tweets.text: 🚨 190+ organisations across 36 countries. n0n ransomware posted 59 victims in 24 hours including claims naming Visa, Mastercard & JPMorgan Chase…

st-jamess-place.title: St James's Place confirms October cyberattack
st-jamess-place.victim: St James's Place (UK wealth manager, ~1M clients)
st-jamess-place.scale: Number of affected clients not disclosed
st-jamess-place.status: Disclosed Nov 24; contained, regulators and affected clients notified
st-jamess-place.summary: The FTSE 100 wealth manager confirmed a late-October incident claimed by Mimori, following attacks on Rathbones and Saltus. It says operations and client access weren't disrupted.

fbi-ncic-breach.title: FBI's national crime database breached
fbi-ncic-breach.scale: NCIC holds 18M+ active records; what was accessed is unconfirmed
fbi-ncic-breach.status: FBI investigating; no group has claimed it
fbi-ncic-breach.summary: The database police query for warrants, stolen property and missing persons was reportedly compromised, the FBI's second reported breach in two months.

tweets.name: CNN NationalSecurity
tweets.text: BREAKING: The FBI was hacked again, this time the breach targeted its crime database, sources tell @evanperez

tweets.name: Clash Report
tweets.text: NEW: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of its National Crime Information Center (NCIC)… The breach is the FBI's second in recent months.

optimizely-supply-chain.title: Optimizely flaw used to plant malware on 178 major websites
optimizely-supply-chain.victim: Optimizely customers incl. BBC, CNN, Zoom, HSBC
optimizely-supply-chain.status: Flaw fixed and code removed; CISA added CVE-2026-132224 to KEV on Nov 24
optimizely-supply-chain.summary: Malicious JavaScript served from Optimizely's own CDN skimmed cards, swapped crypto addresses and tried to push iPhone exploits to visitors of big-name sites.

tweets.name: Scott Helme
tweets.text: This is a big one. We found malicious JavaScript being served through Optimizely to some of the world's largest websites. 178 organisations affected, with everything from crypto theft and card skimming to iOS exploits.

tweets.name: SlowMist
tweets.text: A large-scale JavaScript supply chain attack, dubbed OPTIMJACK, has compromised websites using Optimizely. Researchers identified 188 compromised scripts across 178 organizations…

european-commission-ai-attack.title: European Commission hit by AI-assisted cyberattack
european-commission-ai-attack.attacker: Unknown (Euronews: suspected China link via the Artex tool)
european-commission-ai-attack.scale: Internal systems down 10+ days; EU Academy users' names and emails exposed
european-commission-ai-attack.status: Full extent still under investigation; EU Academy suspended
european-commission-ai-attack.summary: Payroll, health insurance and translation systems were disrupted for over ten days, and the investigation has since found a data breach at the EU Academy learning platform.

tweets.name: POLITICOEurope
tweets.text: EXCLUSIVE: A huge cyberattack has hit the European Commission. The incident has potentially compromised swaths of personal data…

tweets.name: unusual_whales
tweets.text: BREAKING: The European Commission has been hit by a major cyberattack that may have exposed large amounts of staff personal data, per Politico…

tower-records-japan.title: Tower Records Japan leaks ~11 million customer records
tower-records-japan.scale: ~11M records; 10.2M with emails, member IDs and hashed passwords
tower-records-japan.summary: Attackers got into the e-commerce platform and took login records plus names, birth dates and some addresses and phone numbers. No card data, the company says.

tweets.name: J-Pop Project News
tweets.text: "Tower Records Online" service has been temporarily suspended following the leakage of approximately 11 million pieces of personal information…

tweets.name: Bloomberg
tweets.text: Tower Records said customer information was leaked following unauthorized access, making it Japan's latest retailer to disclose a data breach

bell-canada.title: Bell Canada customer data taken by an 'agentic' attacker
bell-canada.victim: Bell, Bell Aliant, Bell MTS, Virgin Plus, Lucky Mobile customers
bell-canada.scale: Residential and business customers; number not disclosed
bell-canada.status: Bell investigating, RCMP investigating; customer notices sent Nov 23
bell-canada.summary: An attacker got into an internal Bell system holding names, addresses, phone numbers, emails, account numbers and last-payment details.

tweets.name: Dark Web Intelligence
tweets.text: UPDATE: Bell Canada says its Nov. 17 breach also hit consumers… Bell says card numbers and bank details were not, and it has not said how many customers were affected.

tweets.name: Jay Bishop
tweets.text: Bell's breach got bigger… No cards taken, but an account number and last payment amount are exactly what a good scam call needs.

france-supermarket-fridges.title: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guard for supermarket fridge sabotage
france-supermarket-fridges.scale: ~700 of France's 10,000 supermarkets; at least 15 fires
france-supermarket-fridges.status: Arrest warrants for three Iranians; France seeking EU sanctions
france-supermarket-fridges.summary: France formally attributed the Oct 11-12 attack that hijacked refrigeration controls and spoiled food. Similar outages hit stores elsewhere in Europe on Nov 2.

osaka-email-provider.title: Email distribution provider hack exposes ~77M addresses, incl. Osaka city
osaka-email-provider.victim: Osaka city and ~400 customers of an email service
osaka-email-provider.status: Disclosed; used to send fraudulent emails
osaka-email-provider.summary: Attackers compromised a third-party email distribution service, exposing customers' mailing lists and sending fraudulent emails.

tsmc-cloud-provider.title: TSMC employee data exposed through a cloud provider
tsmc-cloud-provider.scale: 6.9 GB of alleged employee data advertised
tsmc-cloud-provider.status: TSMC says its own systems and customer data were unaffected
tsmc-cloud-provider.summary: A breach at an unnamed cloud provider exposed TSMC staff information, later advertised on a cybercrime forum.

infoblox-vendor.title: Infoblox customer data accessed via a migration vendor
infoblox-vendor.status: Infoblox says products and services unaffected
infoblox-vendor.summary: A compromised data migration vendor exposed sensitive customer data stored in a migration environment.

binance-heist.title: Binance $6.36B heist, the largest theft on record
binance-heist.status: DOJ moved to forfeit $1.1B in frozen USDC; $2.9B+ frozen, seized or returned
binance-heist.summary: Attackers drained Binance hot wallets in about 20 minutes. Recovery and laundering tracking are still under way.

tweets.name: Wu Blockchain
tweets.text: Investigation: Only $32M recovered three weeks after $6.4B Binance hack, $2.82B frozen… The FBI previously attributed the attack to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor.
